    if matched:
        coworker_spam_threads.append((t, matched))

coworker_spam_thread_ids = [t.get('email_thread_id') for t,_ in coworker_spam_threads]

# Block A: Parse/compose deletion + unspam/unread targets from current spam threads

task_text = "Check my gmail to see if any of my coworkers' email thread has been marked as spam. If so, unspam it and make it unread. Then, delete all spam threads."
print('Task (exact):', task_text)

# Re-fetch spam threads to freeze the deletion scope
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_spam_threads = []
while True:
    resp = apis.gmail.show_spam_threads(access_token=gmail_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_spam_threads.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

print('Fetched spam threads:', len(all_spam_threads))

# Coworker emails from phone contacts (relationship='coworker')
phone_access_token = phone_token
coworker_contacts = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access_token, query='', relationship='coworker', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    coworker_contacts.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
coworker_emails = sorted({c.get('email') for c in coworker_contacts if c.get('email')})
coworker_email_set = set(coworker_emails)

print('Coworker emails resolved from phone contacts:', len(coworker_emails))
print('Coworker emails:', coworker_emails)

# Determine coworker-matching spam threads
coworker_spam_threads = []
for t in all_spam_threads:
    participants_emails = [p.get('email') for p in (t.get('participants') or []) if p.get('email')]
    matched = [e for e in participants_emails if e in coworker_email_set]
    if matched:
        coworker_spam_threads.append((t, matched))

coworker_spam_ids = [t.get('email_thread_id') for t,_ in coworker_spam_threads]

# Deletion scope: all spam thread IDs as fetched
all_spam_thread_ids = [t.get('email_thread_id') for t in all_spam_threads]

# Criteria table (exact quotes)
criteria = [
    ('Unspam + unread scope', "If so, unspam it and make it unread.", 'Threads whose participants include a phone contact with relationship=coworker'),
    ('Delete scope', 'Then, delete all spam threads.', 'All threads currently returned by show_spam_threads')
]
print('\nCRITERIA TABLE')
for name, exact_quote, impl in criteria:
    print(name, '|', exact_quote, '|', impl)

print('\nTarget set counts:')
print('All spam thread IDs:', len(all_spam_thread_ids))
print('Coworker-matching spam thread IDs:', len(coworker_spam_ids))

# Partition delta for unread: mark_thread_unread only for those currently read==True
coworker_threads_needing_unread = []
for t,_ in coworker_spam_threads:
    if t.get('read') is True:
        coworker_threads_needing_unread.append(t.get('email_thread_id'))

print('Coworker threads needing unread toggle (read=True):', len(coworker_threads_needing_unread))

# Verification table for coworker subset
print('\nVERIFICATION TABLE: coworker-matching spam threads')
for t, matched in coworker_spam_threads:
    print({
        'email_thread_id': t.get('email_thread_id'),
        'subject': t.get('subject'),
        'matched_coworker_emails': matched,
        'read': t.get('read'),
        'participants': [(p.get('name'), p.get('email')) for p in (t.get('participants') or [])]
    })

# Verification for deletion scope (show a compact row per thread)
print('\nVERIFICATION TABLE: delete scope (all current spam threads)')
for t in all_spam_threads:
    pid = t.get('email_thread_id')
    subj = t.get('subject')
    read = t.get('read')
    participants_emails = [p.get('email') for p in (t.get('participants') or []) if p.get('email')]
    matched = [e for e in participants_emails if e in coworker_email_set]
    print({
        'email_thread_id': pid,
        'subject': subj,
        'matched_coworker': bool(matched),
        'read': read
    })

# Step 2A: Unspam + unread for coworker-matching spam threads

gmail_token = apis.gmail.login(username='ashlee_martinez@gmail.com', password=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='gmail'][0])['access_token']

# Recompute coworker spam thread IDs from current phone contacts and current spam list (to avoid stale IDs)
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='3506492550', password=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='phone'][0])['access_token']

# fetch coworker emails
coworker_contacts = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='', relationship='coworker', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    coworker_contacts.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
coworker_emails = sorted({c.get('email') for c in coworker_contacts if c.get('email')})
coworker_email_set = set(coworker_emails)

# fetch current spam threads
all_spam_threads = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.gmail.show_spam_threads(access_token=gmail_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_spam_threads.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

coworker_spam_threads = []
for t in all_spam_threads:
    participants_emails = [p.get('email') for p in (t.get('participants') or []) if p.get('email')]
    matched = [e for e in participants_emails if e in coworker_email_set]
    if matched:
        coworker_spam_threads.append((t, matched))

coworker_ids = [t.get('email_thread_id') for t,_ in coworker_spam_threads]
read_true_ids = [t.get('email_thread_id') for t,_ in coworker_spam_threads if t.get('read') is True]

print('Coworker-matching spam thread IDs:', coworker_ids)
print('Coworker thread IDs needing unread (read==True):', read_true_ids)

# Perform unspam + unread
results_unspam = []
for eid in coworker_ids:

results_unread = []

    results_unread.append((eid, r))

print('Unspam results:', results_unspam)
print('Unread results:', results_unread)

# Fetch spam threads after unspam to determine deletion targets
post_unspam_spam_threads = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.gmail.show_spam_threads(access_token=gmail_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    post_unspam_spam_threads.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

post_unspam_spam_ids = [t.get('email_thread_id') for t in post_unspam_spam_threads]

print('Remaining spam thread IDs:', post_unspam_spam_ids)

# Re-fetch remaining spam threads (post-unspam)
